verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developers.contasimples.com (HTTP 200) that indexes the API docs, with per-section index files. First-party docs say every page is also served as Markdown, via a .md suffix or an Accept: text/markdown header, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a consolidated llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance, and no independent user reports of agents actually consuming these docs.
